name: airforce-dashi
description: Air Force Dashi — Three.js / React browser flight arcade

scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w @afd/web && npm run build:api:vercel
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @afd/web && npm run typecheck -w @afd/game-core && npm run typecheck -w @afd/game-render && npm run typecheck -w @afd/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @afd/economy && npm run typecheck -w @afd/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @afd/game-core && npm run test -w @afd/economy && npm run test -w @afd/api
